notes:
v1.6.1 Update
Fixed gacha spectators getting stuck on the first reward when players receive all results at once.
Each spectator window follows the correct draw, including when players advance quickly.
Watching GMs can use View All to inspect every reward in their own window.

announcement.title: 🎁 Unboxing the Mystery v1.6.1
announcement.content:
Unboxing the Mystery v1.6.1 fixes gacha spectator results.

  • Spectators see all rewards when players receive all results at once.
  • Each spectator window follows the correct draw, including when players advance quickly.
  • Watching GMs can use View All to inspect every reward in their own window.
